W.note: Polished graph-and-readout cards with a live marker and reduced-motion Play once, but two of the three curves are near-duplicates and none of them visibly clings.

X.note: Grip Hold is a real grip and the three curves spread well, but the page shows no graph, no measured values and no hold, so the curves are hard to read.

Y.note: The best presentation of the four, with a 1 percent band, settle tick, copyable values and a correct rest state under reduced motion, but its curve set duplicates W's and the sticky card barely lingers.

Z.note: The three curves cover grip, overshoot and snap and each loop holds at both ends, so the feel is the most legible, though the thumbnail graphs carry no measured numbers and the 9.8 percent overshoot clips past the track.
